# Mirage 1.0.8

本版本重点恢复复杂场景壁纸的脚本、动画与渲染兼容性，并重做创意工坊发现页、加入 Steam 收藏同步和更灵活的筛选。还修复了网页音频频谱、多显示器启动恢复、旋转屏幕锁屏壁纸和应用图标等问题。

## 重大更新：场景壁纸兼容性

- 大幅完善 Wallpaper Engine 场景运行时兼容性，恢复脚本驱动的图层可见性与顺序、属性写入、鼠标交互、动画事件、相机切换及木偶动画；动态壁纸不再因运行时状态不同步而静止、交互失效或丢失动画。
- 修复合成层与效果渲染，确保渲染图、着色器、纹理、Metal 桥接纹理和效果绑定在刷新或重建后继续有效；同时拆分大型网格上传，减少复杂场景因资源失效或上传过大而黑屏、缺层或停止播放的情况。
- 扩展场景文档、粒子、模型与木偶数据解析，保留作者定义的图层元数据和标量原点，并修复创意工坊字体路径、文字与不透明背景透明度，提升更多既有壁纸的还原度。

## 重大更新：创意工坊发现与收藏

- 重做“发现”页：按最近好评、当下热门、音频响应、题材、精选创作者和作品集等分区展示内容，支持站内搜索、查看完整分区、分页、刷新及缓存回退。
- 新增 Steam 创意工坊收藏同步，可在壁纸卡片、详情页、右键菜单和已安装壁纸中直接收藏或取消收藏；资料库、创意工坊和已订阅页面均可筛选“我的收藏”。
- “仅显示”筛选现在统一支持广受好评、我的收藏、音频响应和可自定义；创意工坊与已订阅页面还可同时选择场景、网页、视频和预设等多种壁纸类型。修复多标签筛选，勾选多个标签时会显示匹配其中任一标签的作品，不再因要求同时包含全部标签而错误返回空结果。

## 播放与系统修复

- 修复网页壁纸音频频谱的 vDSP 实数 DFT 输入布局，频率不再落入错误的半频位置，高频段也能正确参与音频可视化 (PR #34)。
- 修复多显示器启动时仅检查当前选中屏幕，导致其他显示器已保存的壁纸无法恢复的问题 (PR #33)。
- 修复使用旋转显示器时，锁屏屏保壁纸无法按当前逻辑尺寸铺满的问题 (#24)。
- 修复 Dock 与启动台中的应用图标显示过大的问题 (#23)。

## 界面与稳定性

- 改进创意工坊网格、已订阅工具栏、筛选侧栏和紧凑窗口布局，并扩大主窗口默认与最小尺寸，减少控件挤压、裁切和错位。
- 修复性能设置中的帧率滑块布局不稳定，以及隐藏页面仍影响当前页面布局的问题。

## 下载

- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64`：Intel Mac
- 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本

当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.0.8

This release focuses on restoring scripting, animation, and rendering compatibility for complex Scene wallpapers. It also rebuilds Workshop discovery, adds synchronized Steam favorites, and introduces more flexible filtering. Web audio spectra, multi-display launch restoration, rotated-display screen savers, and application icon sizing are fixed as well.

## Major Update: Scene Wallpaper Compatibility

- Significantly expanded Wallpaper Engine Scene runtime compatibility by restoring script-driven layer visibility and ordering, writable properties, pointer interaction, animation events, camera transitions, and puppet animation. Dynamic wallpapers no longer become static, lose interaction, or drop animations when runtime state falls out of sync.
- Fixed composite and effect rendering so render graphs, shaders, textures, bridged Metal textures, and effect bindings remain valid after refreshes or rebuilds. Large mesh uploads are now split to reduce blank output, missing layers, and stopped playback in complex scenes.
- Expanded Scene document, particle, model, and puppet parsing, preserved authored layer metadata and scalar origins, and fixed Workshop font paths plus text and opaque-background alpha for more faithful rendering of existing wallpapers.

## Major Update: Workshop Discovery and Favorites

- Rebuilt Discover around sections such as recently approved, popular now, audio-responsive, genre, featured creator, and collection content. It now supports in-app search, full-section browsing, pagination, refresh, and cached fallback.
- Added synchronized Steam Workshop favorites. Items can be favorited or unfavorited from cards, details, context menus, and installed wallpapers, while Library, Workshop, and Subscribed views can filter to My Favorites.
- Show Only filters now consistently cover Approved, My Favorites, Audio Responsive, and Customizable. Workshop and Subscribed views can also select multiple wallpaper types, including Scene, Web, Video, and Preset. Multi-tag filtering now returns items matching any selected tag instead of incorrectly requiring every selected tag and often producing empty results.

## Playback and System Fixes

- Fixed the vDSP real-DFT input layout used by web-wallpaper audio spectra. Frequencies no longer appear at half their actual position, and the upper frequency range is represented correctly (PR #34).
- Fixed launch restoration checking only the selected display and consequently skipping persisted wallpapers on other displays (PR #33).
- Fixed screen-saver wallpapers failing to fill the logical display bounds on rotated monitors (#24).
- Fixed oversized application icons in the Dock and Launchpad (#23).

## Interface and Stability

- Improved Workshop grids, the Subscribed toolbar, filter sidebars, and compact-window layouts. The main window also has larger default and minimum dimensions to reduce control compression, clipping, and misalignment.
- Fixed unstable frame-rate slider layout in Performance settings and hidden sections continuing to affect the active page's layout.

## Downloads

- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64` for Intel Mac
- Requires macOS 14.2 or later

Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
